A BlitzLLVM extension: sets how small and how big the user may make a window. Windows holds the window to these sizes while the user drags an edge, and [SetGadgetShape](SetGadgetShape) keeps to them as well. A size of 0 means no limit there. It replaces what [SetMinWindowSize](SetMinWindowSize) set.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Only wider", 20, 20, 240, 160, Desktop(), 15)
SetWindowSizeLimit win, 160, 160, 480, 160 ; Between 160 and 480 wide, always 160 high.
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param window      Handle of a window that can be resized.
@param min_width   Smallest width, 0 for no limit.
@param min_height  Smallest height, 0 for no limit.
@param max_width   Biggest width, 0 for no limit.
@param max_height  Biggest height, 0 for no limit.
@gap Not in the original, which only has [SetMinWindowSize](SetMinWindowSize) and lets a window grow as big as the desktop. A program there that keeps a window smaller has to shrink it back after the user resized it.
